messages:
sam: hey folks — pushed the follow-ups from review on #4321 and rebased onto main. PTAL when you get a sec. i split the big test into two and added the changelog entry.
priya: thanks sam, i'll take a look this afternoon. did you run the smoke job locally?
sam: yep — `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --subset quick` passed locally. added the output snippet in the PR description.
alex: quick heads-up: we have a canary slot at 4pm PT today, if this is going into the canary window we should decide soon.
maria: i can be merge custodian if you want — but i need a final approval from priya or alex first.
sam: appreciated maria. priya, alex — any blocking comments left? i addressed the major nits and the logging cleanup.
priya: one tiny nit in the serializer comment (left inline). otherwise LGTM from me once that's fixed.
sam: fixed, pushed. thanks.
merge-bot: [auto] CI passed for commit a1b2c3d — all checks green. :white_check_mark:
alex: i skimmed — looks good. alex: approving now. :thumbsup:
maria: i'm on standby to merge at 16:05 PT and will monitor canary metrics for 15m after rollout. can someone add me to the release note?
sam: added you and the rollout checklist to the PR description. also documented the fallback flag and how to rollback.
priya: approved and left a follow-up TODO in the backlog for the serializer refactor.
maria: thanks — i'll merge at 16:05 and ping #release when it's live.
sam: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:
merge-bot: merged by maria at 1714242650 — canary rollout started. logs: `kubectl rollout status deployment/frontend  --namespace prod`.
priya: good job team — will watch the metrics dashboard for the next 30m and report if anything odd shows up.
alex: thanks all.
